name: onboarding-checklist-builder
description: Builds the per-joiner onboarding checklist and the trackable dashboard, part of the Onboarding Pack by 90n and Terry Mattheoyianni. Use this whenever the user says "run onboarding-checklist-builder", "make the onboarding checklist", "build the onboarding dashboard", "how do I track where we are with Maria's onboarding", or a pre-boarding plan exists and needs to become something people can tick. Use it even for "what's left before her start date".

findings.excerpt: - **Host it for the team:** put the current file at a URL so anyone can SEE status. Simplest path is Vercel: create a free account at vercel.com, drag the folde
